dish.title: Xi'an Cumin Lamb Stir-Fry with Jasmine Rice

recipe_version.title: Xi'an Cumin Lamb Stir-Fry with Jasmine Rice
recipe_version.description: Thin slices of lamb seared hard in a wok with whole cumin seeds, dried chile flakes, Sichuan peppercorn, garlic, ginger, and onion until crisp-edged and fragrant, finished with scallions and cilantro. A bold, dry-spiced northwestern Chinese stir-fry over rice.

ingredients.name: thin-sliced lamb
ingredients.display_name: store-bought thin-sliced lamb (hot-pot slices, or lamb shoulder sliced 1/8 inch thick by the butcher)
ingredients.note: Buy it already sliced. Frozen hot-pot slices are thawed in the refrigerator the day before; thawing is outside the cooking clock.
ingredients.preparation: slices separated; long pieces cut into 2-inch lengths

ingredients.name: cumin seeds
ingredients.preparation: half left whole, half coarsely crushed

steps.title: Start the rice and prep
steps.body: Combine the rinsed rice and 2 1/4 cups water in a 2-quart saucepan, bring to a boil, cover, and cook on low 15 minutes, then rest covered; it cooks inside this prep and the stir-fry (overlap stated). Separate the lamb slices, cut any long pieces into 2-inch lengths, and toss with the soy sauce, cornstarch, and 1/2 tsp salt. Crush half the cumin. Toast and grind the Sichuan peppercorns. Cut the onion, garlic, ginger, scallions, and cilantro.

steps.title: Sear the lamb
steps.body: Heat the wok over very high heat until smoking, add 1 tbsp oil, and spread half the lamb in one layer. Sear 1 minute without moving, then stir-fry 1 minute until browned and crisp at the edges. Lift out and repeat with 1 tbsp oil and the rest of the lamb.

steps.title: Toast the spices and onion
steps.body: Add the last 1 tbsp oil, the onion, garlic, and ginger and stir-fry 2 minutes. Add the whole and crushed cumin, chile flakes, and Sichuan pepper and toss 30 seconds until fragrant.

steps.title: Combine
steps.body: Return the lamb with the scallions and the remaining 1/4 tsp salt and toss 1 minute over high heat. Take off the heat and toss in the cilantro.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Fluff the rice and pile the lamb beside or over it.

equipment: wok or 12-inch carbon-steel or cast-iron skillet
